description: Light and dark qBittorrent 5.3 themes for Windows, including compact variants.
notes: Downloads the official Noorjahan Setup ZIP, Web UI ZIP, and update-webui.ps1 helper. The four standalone .qbtheme downloads are unnecessary because the exact same theme files are already included in Noorjahan-Setup.zip.
Noorjahan-Setup.zip extracts to the Noorjahan-Setup folder under this Scoop app directory. It contains install.ps1, Install Noorjahan.cmd, the Inter fonts, and all four .qbtheme files.

Run $dir\Noorjahan-Setup\Install Noorjahan.cmd manually only when you want to install Inter for the current Windows user, copy the themes into %APPDATA%\qBittorrent\themes, and optionally change qBittorrent.ini. The script backs up qBittorrent.ini before changing it; Scoop does not run this installer automatically.
Alternatively, in qBittorrent open Tools > Options > Behavior, enable the custom UI theme, and select a theme from $dir\Noorjahan-Setup. Restart qBittorrent to apply it.
Noorjahan-WebUI.zip extracts to the Noorjahan-WebUI folder under this Scoop app directory. In qBittorrent open Tools > Options > Web UI, enable Use alternative WebUI, and select $dir\Noorjahan-WebUI.
Run $dir\update-webui.ps1 from PowerShell when you want to update the configured Noorjahan Web UI. Scoop does not execute it automatically.
